name: Kitten Game 🐾
desc:
🐾Become a cat, collect fun accessories, play with friends, and explore!

🎃[October Update]

Celebrate October with new Halloween kittens and accessories! 

- Jinx: Summon spooky cats! 
- Lilith: Blur the line between light and darkness.
- Zombie: Become undead!

16 new accessories have also been added. Check them out!

Controls:
Run [desktop]🖥️: R
Run [console]🎮: L3

⭐Join the group for awesome stuff!
